questions.question: How does Psalm 22 begin?
options: 'Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD'
'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want'
'Have mercy on me, O God, according to your love'
'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?'
questions.answer: 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?'

questions.question: What do David's enemies do to his clothing?
options: Divide his garments and cast lots for his clothing
Pierce both his hands and his feet through with nails
Mock him aloud and wag their heads at him in scorn
Offer him only sour wine to drink in his great thirst
questions.answer: Divide his garments and cast lots for his clothing
